articles.title: Tether's U.S.-focused stablecoin grows over 500% in a month, but still lags main rivals
articles.snippet: USAT's market cap jumped above $140 million in April, though it remains well behind Circle's USDC, PayPal's PYUSD and Ripple's RLUSD tokens.

articles.title: UniCredit warns Europe may struggle to contain crypto-bank crisis under MiCA rules
articles.snippet: EU deposit insurance (up to €100,000) may not absorb stress from large stablecoin reserve accounts, unlike the full protection offered by U.S. regulators.

articles.title: Toddlers learn by falling: Why DeFi's $20 billion TVL drop is just a market stress-test
articles.snippet: DeFi Technologies president Andrew Forson says the stablecoin layer is thriving, with more than $150 billion in U.S. Treasuries backing coins like USDT and USDC.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Asia’s regulated crypto future
articles.snippet: Asia's adoption of crypto and stablecoins is driving regulated growth in payments and remittances. Learn how Singapore, Hong Kong, India, and Korea are leading the way.

articles.title: Trezor adds native USDt, USDC yield via Morpho integration
articles.snippet: The feature lets users earn stablecoin yield directly through Trezor Suite without connecting external wallets or using separate DeFi apps.
